name: @jfrusher/trousseau
description: The shared data contract behind Tableaux, Plaque, Cadence and Brigade.

scripts.verify: npm run build && tsc -p verify/tsconfig.json && node -e "import('./dist/index.js')"
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test && npm run verify
scripts.data:validate: npm run build && node scripts/validate-wedding.mjs data/wedding.trousseau.json
scripts.data:status: python -m dvc status && python -m dvc data status
scripts.data:push: npm run data:validate && python -m dvc add data/wedding.trousseau.json data/exports && python -m dvc push
